critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 (No Partial Status): Backend code at line 1728 correctly prevents 'partial' status. Only 'approved' or 'rejected' are used for new approvals.
Bug Fix 2 (Mandatory Reject Reason): Frontend validation at line 129-136 ensures reject reason is required for rejected dates.
Bug Fix 3 (Admin Edit/Delete): PUT /admin-edit and DELETE /admin-delete endpoints exist and work for all leave statuses.
Bug Fix 4 (Working Hours Grouped by Date): WorkEntry.js groups entries by date with View button for project breakdown.
Bug Fix 5 (Total Assigned Projects): WorkEntry.js shows 'Total Assigned Projects' stat instead of 'Total Records'.
Bug Fix 6 (Leave Submenu): Layout.js has collapsible Leave submenu with Tracker, Approval, History for admin/hr roles.

Bug Fix 1 - No Partial Status.details: Backend code prevents 'partial' status. New approvals use only 'approved' or 'rejected'. Legacy data with 'partial' still exists but is not created by new code.

Bug Fix 2 - Mandatory Reject Reason.details: Frontend validation requires reject reason for all rejected dates. Input field appears when 'Rejected' is selected.

Bug Fix 3 - Admin Edit/Delete.details: PUT /admin-edit and DELETE /admin-delete endpoints exist. Edit and Delete buttons visible in Approved and Rejected tabs.

Bug Fix 4 - Working Hours Grouped by Dat.details: Employee Working Hours shows one row per date with View button for project breakdown dialog.

Bug Fix 5 - Total Assigned Projects.details: 'Total Assigned Projects' stat displayed instead of 'Total Records' in Employee Working Hours page.

Bug Fix 6 - Leave Submenu Structure.details: Leave menu is collapsible with submenus: Leave Tracker, Leave Approval, Leave History for admin/hr roles.
